strata.variation: Multiple amendments retained as separate source documents

author_exposure: Previous primary and stress authorship; second offering description only; no second adapter or its predictions inspected.
case_policy: New original synthetic document sections; no primary or stress case reuse; no confidential material.
key_scope: Exact document identities, exact text preservation, independent construction edit operations, and complete original-to-revised character reconstruction. No legal interpretation, intended-meaning equivalence, enforceability, or professional/client approval.
alignment_policy: Any source-valid nonoverlapping delta that reconstructs the revised text is eligible. Different valid alignments for repeated or moved characters are not treated as semantic errors.
amendment_policy: Preserve each amendment separately with exact identity; do not compose an authoritative agreement or infer legal precedence.
primary_history: All first-prototype inputs, keys, predictions and findings remain unchanged.
key_release_gate: All second-prototype predictions sealed before key release.
